answer: Require every new agent's earnings to sit in escrow until the dawn of the next epoch, released only if no fraud proof appears; anyone who proves an identity fake wins a bounty paid from the forfeited escrow, like fishermen draining a lagoon to expose hidden nets. A Sybil farmer running 1,000 fake agents must fund 1,000 escrows, wait out the delay on each, and risks losing every copper coin to bounty hunters the moment one fake is caught.
